title: Auth notifications, options export, and account-scoped Perihelion tags
content:
Auth and Perihelion completed a comprehensive notification, options management, and account scoping release.

Key highlights:

  • Batch Notification Consolidation & Plain Text JSON: Multi-element batch operations (such as Perihelion zip exports) now log as a single consolidated notification event. Direct JSON links are rendered on the metadata row (SYSTEM, SITE, ACCT, DATE) and open directly in the browser as formatted plain text.
  • Notifications & Options UI Streamlining: Added Select All and Deselect All filter links directly beneath the AFFECTED SITE and NOTIFICATION TRIGGER column headers, removed the redundant ALL display button, and added dedicated Export Activity and Export Notifications buttons to the Options page.
  • Account-Scoped Tags & Lists with PrefAdmin Aggregation: Perihelion tags and lists are now strictly partitioned per account for standard users and regadmins, while prefadmin retains aggregate visibility across all accounts. Standardized the signed-out footer copyright block to match Auth.
